desc: 夹缝窄身可推到位，万向轮移动，多层分区收纳，卧室书房客厅通用
name: 卧室窄身可移动收纳书柜款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒讲清窄身落地收纳定位，用真实卧室阅读角和家具尺度让人代入自己家。
shots.textZone: top-left block: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 plus kicker pill 「{callout_1}」 and two thin-line icon labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把选择理由压成一眼可读的四格薄描线图标，承接首屏继续给购买理由。
shots.textZone: left column: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 over a 2x2 grid of monoline icons each labelled 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用同机位分屏放大床头与沙发边那段被浪费又被杂物占满的窄缝，逼出收纳需求。
shots.textZone: top band on #2F4B57 with headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one small label 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 侧面正交机位证明窄身厚度真的能贴进沙发与墙之间，给出可用场景与尺度。
shots.textZone: right vertical margin: kicker 「{callout_1}」 and one label 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 极低角度微距把可移动这个核心卖点坐实：轮体、转向结构和落地接触全部看得见。
shots.textZone: bottom band: one label 「{callout_1}」 with a 1px leader line to the wheel

shots.intent: 正俯视交代顶层台面可用性与开口进深，把陈列与放置逻辑一次说清。
shots.textZone: four numbered circles with short labels 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_4}」 along the right edge

shots.intent: 用正交立面加引线把顶层陈列、中层常用、底层重物的分区逻辑讲成可执行的收纳方案。
shots.textZone: right label column: three blocks 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 each with a 1px leader line to its tier, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top

shots.intent: 同光同框对比平摊堆放与带前挡条层板立放，让人自己看出整理效率的差。
shots.textZone: two small corner labels 「{callout_1}」 on the left panel and 「{callout_2}」 on the right panel

shots.intent: 一排等距规格让买家按自家缝宽选层数与宽度，把选型犹豫收在这一步。
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_1}」 under each unit in a single aligned baseline row

shots.intent: 用后侧微距把边框节点、层板托位与背侧结构摊开给人看，靠可见做工而非证书降低风险。
shots.textZone: three monoline icons with labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 along the bottom edge

shots.intent: 傍晚台灯下的阅读角收口，把整页情绪落回可推可享的日常，再给一个明确动作。
shots.textZone: lower third: closing line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #F2EEE8 and one button-shaped label 「{callout_1}」 on #C29A5B

style.backgroundSystem: real interior surfaces kept uncluttered: matte plaster wall, pale oak plank floor, one ink-slate graphic field for infographic screens; a single clean text zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: quiet premium mobile-storage furniture ecommerce, editorial rather than cozy-lifestyle
style.iconSystem: 1.5px monoline thin-line pictograms only, #F2EEE8 strokes on the ink-slate field and #2F4B57 strokes on the off-white field, simple geometric shapes, maximum four per screen, no filled illustration, no 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: one hard directional side key at 4300K from a declared single side, crisp long cast shadow plus soft bounce fill on the shadow side, raking light along shelf edges and frame joints, visible contact shadow under feet or wheels; never flat shadowless studio
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium mobile-storage furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper off-white #F2EEE8, deep ink-slate #2F4B57, pale oak #C8BCAD and one amber accent #C29A5B; neutral tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; background system of real interior surfaces (matte plaster wall, pale oak plank floor) plus one ink-slate graphic field, each screen keeping a single clean text zone; lighting system of one hard directional side key at 4300K with a crisp long cast shadow, soft bounce fill on the shadow side, raking light along shelf edges and frame joints, and a visible contact shadow under the feet or wheels; surface system that renders the reference material and finish exactly as supplied, matte, edge-lit; layout system of generous left or top copy margin, 1px leader lines, numbered circles and at most four thin-line icons; icon system of 1.5px monoline pictograms in #F2EEE8 on ink-slate and #2F4B57 on off-white; product presentation rules: identical proportions, tier count and footprint in every frame, standing on the floor with contact shadow, straight verticals, real furniture as scale anchor, reused 3/4 hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cozy soft-focus tint, no invented dimensions, grades or certificates.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or contradictory shadow directions
no invented dimensions, materials, grades or certificates
style.presentationRules: the unit keeps identical proportions, tier count and footprint in every frame; standing on the floor with visible contact shadow, never floating; verticals kept straight; real furniture used as scale anchor; hero 3/4 angle reused across scene screens so the product reads as one object
style.surfaceSystem: matte-finished frame members and shelf faces rendered exactly as the reference material, edges caught by raking light; wheel and hardware surfaces shown at low grazing angle; no gloss repaint
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline 28-34pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt; generous left or top margin reserved for copy, no dense body text
